clue.text: Study technique, showing good sense

parts.note: to con is an old word meaning to study or learn by heart
science in the sense of a skill or technique, as in 'the science of batting'

explanation.surface: A study method is praised for its sound judgement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'showing' is a link word. CON is old-fashioned for studying a text closely.
explanation.definitionFit: Conscience is the inner moral sense that tells right from wrong, a kind of good sense.

clue.text: Duck enclosure without fencing

parts.note: a duck in cricket is a score of nothing, shaped like the letter O
a pen is a small enclosure for animals

explanation.surface: A farmyard pen for ducks with a fence around it.
explanation.walkthrough: The printed 'with' must be 'without': ground with no fencing is open. A duck is a cricket score of zero.
explanation.definitionFit: Land with no fences or barriers around it is open country.

clue.text: Ladies made up and set forth

indicators.note: made up in the sense of put together anew, so these letters are assembled in a fresh order

explanation.surface: Some women put on their make-up and then went out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'made up' looks like cosmetics but signals rearranging LADIES.
explanation.definitionFit: To have sailed is to have set out on a voyage, departed by ship.

clue.text: Irritating one about cutting an item

parts.note: the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: cutting means slicing into the word, so the letter for about sits inside it

parts.note: an item is a thing
c is short for circa, Latin for about

explanation.surface: Someone annoying is talking about slicing a product.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cutting' puts C inside THING to make TCHING, after I.
explanation.definitionFit: An itching rash is one that irritates and makes you want to scratch.

clue.text: The new star will turn a number

annotationWithheld.why: 'The new star will turn a number (4)': NOVA reversed is AVON, but no reading of 'a number' gives AVON or the pieces of NOVA; likely misprinted and no source found.
annotationWithheld.clue: The new star will turn a number

clue.text: Serious result of Eastern involvement

indicators.note: involvement suggests the letters being wound up together and coming out in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Grave consequences follow an Eastern power getting involved.
explanation.walkthrough: 'result of' is a link; 'involvement' signals that EASTERN is rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone earnest is sincere and solemn rather than joking.

clue.text: Still no subject for debate?

parts.note: a motion is the proposal a debating society argues over
the suffix -less means without, having no

explanation.surface: A question whether there is nothing left to argue about.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'no subject for debate' as a debate topic plus the suffix meaning 'without'.
explanation.definitionFit: Something motionless is perfectly still, not moving at all.

clue.text: Old king accompanied by good man and good sport may be seen here

definitions.text: good sport may be seen here

parts.note: GR stands for Georgius Rex, King George
accompanied by is another way of saying and
ST, saint, is a good man in crosswords
taken as written

explanation.surface: A list of distinguished people, a king and a saint, watching a game.
explanation.walkthrough: GR is the royal cipher of a King George, seen on old British postboxes.
explanation.definitionFit: A grandstand is the main covered stand at a sports ground, where spectators watch.

clue.text: Ancient city by a river or stream

indicators.note: by means placed next to, so the city sits beside the river

parts.note: the Po is the great river of northern Italy
Ur is the ancient Sumerian city of Abraham

explanation.surface: An old settlement on the banks of a river or brook.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stream' is a verb here, and 'or' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: To pour is to flow out steadily, as water streams from a jug.

clue.text: Find out, not for the first time, about underworld protection

definitions.text: Find out, not for the first time

parts.note: re means about or concerning, as in letters
Dis is the Roman god of the underworld and his realm
cover is shelter or protection

explanation.surface: A second discovery concerning how gangsters are shielded.
explanation.walkthrough: 'underworld' suggests gangsters but means the classical realm of the dead, Dis.
explanation.definitionFit: To rediscover something is to learn of it again after it was lost or forgotten.

clue.text: 12 holding it back? Fancy!

indicators.note: holding means the time of day wraps around the other piece

parts.note: twelve o'clock midday is noon

indicators.note: back means the little word it is turned to face the other way

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A cross-reference that pretends to be about a number holding something back.
explanation.walkthrough: '12' looks like a pointer to another clue in the grid, but it is just the hour of midday. 'back' and 'holding' do the work; 'Fancy!' is not an exclamation but the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A fancy is a whim or idea, which is what a notion is.

clue.text: A university's interpretation

definitions.meaning: An English town with a university
a ... of a text is one way of interpreting it

explanation.definitionFit: Reading is a university town west of London, and a reading of a play or law is an interpretation of it.

clue.text: Holding it up of late just like the taciturn guys!

indicators.note: holding means the word for lately wraps around the other piece

parts.note: of late means recently

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the word it is read from bottom to top

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Quiet men keeping something to themselves lately.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' only works as a reversal because this is a down clue, read from bottom to top. The definition is an adverb phrase: acting the way quiet, close-mouthed men do.
explanation.definitionFit: Taciturn people speak little, behaving with restraint and reserve.

clue.text: The look a copper managed in absence of conflict

parts.note: p is a penny, a copper coin

indicators.note: in means the word for managed goes inside the word for absence of conflict

parts.note: peace is freedom from war or conflict
to run something is to manage it

explanation.surface: A police officer's expression when calm prevails.
explanation.walkthrough: 'copper' suggests a policeman, but it is a penny, a copper coin. 'in' signals the container; the surface's picture of a calm officer hides it.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone's appearance is how they look to others.

clue.text: People go for this colour

definitions.meaning: at traffic lights and crossings pedestrians go on the signal of this colour
a colour of the spectrum, between yellow and blue

explanation.definitionFit: A green light means go, so people set off when it shows; it is also the colour of grass.

clue.text: Climbs, since little money's needed

parts.note: as can mean since, as in 'as it rained'
cents are small coins

explanation.surface: Ascending costs only a few pennies.
explanation.walkthrough: 'needed' and the 's are links.
explanation.definitionFit: Ascents are upward journeys up mountains, i.e. climbs.

clue.text: The Italian is eager to include a Mediterranean plant

indicators.note: to include means the run of letters sits inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: An Italian man is keen to grow a southern European herb.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The' is a link word; the answer runs across 'ItaliAN IS Eager'.
explanation.definitionFit: Anise is an aromatic herb of the eastern Mediterranean, grown for its liquorice-flavoured seeds.

clue.text: A general concession

definitions.meaning: Ulysses S. ... was the Union general in the American Civil War

explanation.definitionFit: Grant led the Union armies; a grant is also a sum or right conceded by an authority.

clue.text: Do secretarial work of a sort

definitions.meaning: to use a keyboard to produce letters

explanation.definitionFit: Typists key in documents, office work; a type is also a kind or sort of thing.

clue.text: Helen's mother, the Franco American lawyer

parts.note: le is French for the, so a Franco 'the'
a DA is a district attorney in the US

explanation.surface: Family history of a woman whose mother was a French-American attorney.
explanation.walkthrough: In Greek myth Helen of Troy was born to Leda after Zeus visited her as a swan.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth Leda, seduced by Zeus as a swan, bore Helen of Troy.

clue.text: Sound meals cause some annoyance!

indicators.note: sound here means the word is said out loud and spelt as another word

parts.note: teas are light afternoon meals

explanation.surface: Noisy eating at mealtimes irritates others.
explanation.walkthrough: Tea in Britain can mean a light afternoon meal or an evening meal.
explanation.definitionFit: To tease someone is to provoke or mock them playfully, annoying them.

clue.text: Means of riot-control that's sure to affect the viewers

definitions.text: Means of riot-control that's sure to affect the viewers

parts.words: Means of riot-control that's sure to affect the viewers
parts.note: the viewers are the eyes, which a crowd-dispersing chemical makes stream

explanation.definitionFit: Police use this irritant to disperse crowds, and it makes the eyes water.

clue.text: Stretchy lace — it's woven in a new way

indicators.note: weaving the threads into a new pattern means the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A stretchy lace has been woven by a novel method.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram of LACE plus ITS gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Elastic material stretches and springs back.

clue.text: When caught move quickly-appear humble

parts.note: C is the cricket scorecard abbreviation for caught
to hasten is to hurry

explanation.surface: Someone caught out hurries off looking sheepish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'When' and 'appear' are link words; the answer is a verb meaning to humble.
explanation.definitionFit: To chasten someone is to subdue or humble them, often by rebuke.

clue.text: Pleased, oddly enough, to be passed

indicators.note: oddly suggests the letters are in a strange order and must be rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone happy, strangely, to be overlooked.
explanation.walkthrough: 'oddly' does not pick odd letters here; it signals rearranging PLEASED.
explanation.definitionFit: Time that has elapsed has passed or gone by.

clue.text: Bearing in a figure for a top man

indicators.note: in means the bearing goes inside the word for figure

parts.note: a price is the figure asked
N, north, is a compass bearing

explanation.surface: A dignified bearing gives a leader a fine figure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bearing' suggests deportment but is a compass point.
explanation.definitionFit: A prince ranks at the very top among royals and nobles.

clue.text: Some men living alone are rather less generous

indicators.note: some means only part of the following words is used

explanation.surface: Bachelors living alone tend to be rather mean.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer runs across 'aloNE ARE Rather'. In Britain 'near' can mean stingy.
explanation.definitionFit: Near is an old British word for stingy, so nearer means meaner.

clue.text: An enchanting creature gets around

definitions.meaning: a fairy-like being of Persian legend
the Greek-derived prefix meaning around, as in perimeter

explanation.definitionFit: A peri is a beautiful spirit in Persian myth, and peri- is the prefix meaning round about.

clue.text: Article left to a singer

parts.note: a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A piece of writing bequeathed to a vocalist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Article' suggests a newspaper piece but is the grammatical article.
explanation.definitionFit: An alto sings the lower female or highest male voice part.

clue.text: Connection of major with pawnbroker

parts.note: major means great
uncle is old slang for a pawnbroker

explanation.surface: A military major linked to a moneylender.
explanation.walkthrough: 'major' suggests an army rank. 'Uncle' is old slang for a pawnbroker. 'of' and 'with' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: A great-uncle is a family relation, a grandparent's brother.

clue.text: Trainee one producing beautiful stuff

parts.note: L is the learner sign on British cars
an ace is the one on dice and cards

explanation.surface: An apprentice makes lovely things.
explanation.walkthrough: Learner drivers in Britain show an L plate. 'producing' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Lace is a delicate open fabric prized for its beauty.

clue.text: Acquired the power with set-end application

definitions.text: Acquired the power with set-end application

parts.words: Acquired the power with set-end application
parts.note: a television set or appliance gains electric power when its plug or switch at the end is applied

explanation.definitionFit: A device that is activated has had electricity turned on to it.
